ValidationRule.description: If coupon used on is duty free, ticket no and emd no and mileage equivalent should not be entered
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Used_On__c, "Duty Free" ) && ( NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_TKT_No__c )) || NOT(ISBLANK( CPN_Used_on_EMD_No__c )) || NOT(ISBLANK( Mileage_Equivalent__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please only enter Ticket No., EMD No. and Mileage Equivalent if the coupon is used on this item
